C1325.title: Shadow AI Drives Average Data Breach Cost Up by $670,000
C1325.summary: IBM 2025 Cost of a Data Breach Report showed that high levels of shadow AI add 670,000 US dollars to the global average cost of a data breach. Breaches involving shadow AI are harder to detect and contain, with average time to identify and contain reaching 241 days, highlighting the financial and security impact of unauthorized AI use, unaudited data input, and business units connecting external AI tools on their own.
